title: Muhr al-Nubuwwa ('The Seal of Prophethood')

date.basis: MK: 'completed before' the date of the Majlis 10196 copy (f. 189a), asterisked as probably a date of transcription; both the date and the place (Shiraz) are taken from Āqā Buzurg (al-Dharīʿa, 22/296, no. 9048).

manuscript: 3 items listed: MS Majlis 10196 f. 189a (4 Jumādā II 831/21 March 1428); Sipahsālār MS 2930/4 (undated); Princeton MS 2002/4 (1094/1683).
summary: A treatise in a preface and two sections that refers the reader at the end to the K. al-Iṣbāḥ; the entry gives no fuller account of its subject.
